author: ParentCallerCP1

supersedes_partially.note: 001 remains immutable; this amendment adds the CP2 identity join that a pre-invocation attestation alone cannot cover (endedness is only observable over the census snapshots served DURING the PRT call).

cp2_design_freeze.cp1_join_required: union.state CLOSED_CONDITIONAL; spec.identities typed-equal union.prt_identities; PRT census argument is the make_census callable; evaluate_endedness over snapshots served during that PRT call ENDED_CONDITIONAL; receipt binds union_sha256 and endedness digest

actual_result: Source text drafted in memory only (constants/helpers); nothing written to the source path; no compile/import/execution. Exact v3 result/disposition/registry shapes received from the PRT owner; CP2 join fields queried from ParentIdentityCP2.

amendment.signature: invoke_release(owner, spec, reader, census, owned_date, deadline_check, identity)->CallerOutcome; identity exact dict {union, census_log, evaluate_endedness}
amendment.pre_invocation: detach union (bounded JSON); format parent-release-identity-union-v1, state CLOSED_CONDITIONAL, hex union_sha256, prt_identities typed-equal detached spec.identities using CP1's own typed equality (independent of CP2 helper); served count read through CP2's public accessor (exact int) recorded as served_before. Failure => CP1_IDENTITY_UNION, PRT not invoked.
amendment.pass_through: census passed unchanged as PRT census argument; CP1 never calls census itself.
amendment.post_result: after the complete RELEASED result predicate and BEFORE disposition/registry readback and receipt: evaluate_endedness(detached union, census_log, deadline_check) through the same original-deadline callback wrapper; detach result; format parent-release-identity-endedness-v1, state ENDED_CONDITIONAL, causes [], hex endedness_sha256, echoed union_sha256 equal when present; served_after == served_before + 1 (exactly one served snapshot per PRT call). Failure/Exception => CP1_ENDEDNESS (reservation HELD, no receipt); BaseException => attach HELD outcome, re-raise.
amendment.receipt_binding: identity {union_format, union_sha256, endedness_format, endedness_sha256, served_before, served_after, origin}
amendment.provenance: That the census/log/evaluator objects are the pinned CP2 module's, and that the union is the authentic complete historical union, stays named prerequisite identity_union_census_cp2 (parent-asserted attestation); CP1 cannot authenticate in-process callables.
